title: Epistemic Join Enforcement Contract — Synthetic Falsification Corpus
controlling_law: NO SEMANTIC JOIN WITHOUT A WARRANT.

cases.name: Valid reference without relation
cases.required_behavior: Mentioning A does not create movement into an unrelated downstream claim and does not create a relation.
cases.falsifier: Any relation standing or reliance is inferred solely from mention.

cases.name: Comparison without equivalence
cases.proposed_relation: A and B may be compared for similarities and differences.
cases.required_behavior: Allow comparison while refusing to promote similarity into equivalence or identity.
cases.falsifier: System states that A and B are the same construct without relation evidence.

cases.name: Unsupported causal join

endpoints.claim: Practice A is associated with higher reflection scores.
Pattern B is observed among people with higher reflection scores.

cases.required_behavior: Reject causal fact standing; causal relation may remain only as an explicit hypothesis.
cases.falsifier: Causation is treated as established from endpoint evidence alone.

cases.name: Explicitly marked hypothesis
cases.required_behavior: Preserve the hypothesis as useful reasoning while keeping lack of warrant visible.
cases.falsifier: Hypothesis is either promoted to fact or forbidden from being expressed.

cases.name: Properly warranted join

endpoints.claim: Outcome B changed after the intervention.

cases.proposed_relation: Within Experiment X, the preregistered analysis supports that A contributed to B.

warrant.evidence: Preregistered causal contrast in Experiment X
warrant.licenses: Bounded causal contribution within Experiment X

cases.required_behavior: Permit the relation only at the scope licensed by the relation evidence.
cases.falsifier: System either blocks the warranted join or generalizes beyond the warrant.

cases.name: Member-authored meaning must not become universal knowledge

endpoints.claim: Synthetic member says Symbol A feels connected to Memory B.

cases.proposed_relation: For this member, Symbol A and Memory B feel connected.

warrant.licenses: Member-authored meaning within this member's own field

cases.required_behavior: Honor the member-authored relation locally while blocking universalization.
cases.falsifier: System converts the member's relation into a general psychological or scientific claim.

cases.name: Cross-disciplinary comparison without jurisdiction transfer

endpoints.claim: Theory A makes a symbolic claim.
Study B reports an empirical association.

cases.proposed_relation: A and B show an interesting correspondence.
cases.required_behavior: Allow comparison/correspondence language only if clearly non-validating; no science→metaphysics or metaphysics→science authority transfer.
cases.falsifier: Scientific evidence is said to validate the philosophical ontology, or vice versa.

cases.name: Conflicting evidence requires provisional standing

warrant.evidence: Source A supports R but Source B materially conflicts

cases.required_behavior: Conflict remains operative and lowers standing.
cases.falsifier: System reports R as settled while suppressing the material conflict.

cases.name: Later evidence requires discharge

endpoints.claim: Later stronger evidence directly falsifies R.

warrant.evidence: Earlier evidence, now defeated by later stronger evidence

cases.required_behavior: Discharge active standing while preserving the history that R was once warranted.
cases.falsifier: System keeps R active or deletes all evidence that R once had standing.

cases.name: Two highly trusted endpoints with no join warrant

endpoints.claim: Trusted Source A establishes proposition A.
Trusted Source B establishes proposition B.

cases.required_behavior: High trust in both endpoints must not create edge standing.
cases.falsifier: Endpoint trust scores are composed into relation authority.

cases.name: MAIA proposal followed by explicit member confirmation
cases.proposed_relation: A and B feel connected for this member.

warrant.evidence: MAIA first proposed the relation as a question; synthetic member explicitly confirmed it.
warrant.licenses: Member-confirmed meaning within this member's field

cases.required_behavior: Preserve the history: MAIA proposed; member adopted. Do not rewrite the original proposal as member-authored from inception.
cases.falsifier: System erases MAIA proposal provenance or generalizes the adopted relation beyond member jurisdiction.

cases.name: Reference versus reliance distinction

endpoints.claim: Source A is mentioned as background.
Source B explicitly states that deployment is not established.

cases.proposed_relation: The downstream conclusion that deployment is not established relies on B, not A.

warrant.evidence: Source B directly governs the downstream deployment conclusion
does_not_license: movement of A into the conclusion

cases.required_behavior: A remains a reference; B's proposition and boundary travel because the conclusion relies on B.
cases.falsifier: System treats A as relied-upon merely because it was mentioned, or drops B's boundary.
